text: Professional Overview: Energy and power is an important basic industry in the national economy and also one of the fundamental directions for national technological development. This major serves the energy and power industry and is dedicated to the development of fossil energy and new energy, as well as the efficient and clean utilization of energy. It closely integrates with the demands of national energy transformation and plays a significant role in areas such as energy conservation and emission reduction, efficient power equipment, and the utilization of new energy.Training Objectives: To cultivate advanced engineering talents who are in line with the needs of socialist modernization and economic development, with comprehensive development in morality, intelligence, and physical fitness, and who possess a solid theoretical foundation in the field of energy and power engineering, as well as a strong foundation in mechanical design. They will systematically master the knowledge of efficient conversion and utilization of conventional energy and new energy, the power system and its automatic control and operation, and the professional knowledge of energy environmental protection.Main Courses: Theory of Mechanics, Mechanics of Materials, Engineering Drawing, Fundamentals of Mechanical Design, Fundamentals of Engineering Materials, Electrical and Electronic Technology, Principles of Automatic Control, Energy and Power Testing Technology, Computer Programming, Engineering Thermodynamics, Heat Transfer, Fluid Mechanics, Combustion, etc.Professional Characteristics: It has formed the characteristics of "combining traditional energy with new energy and having a wide range of professional adaptability". Through learning the theories of energy conversion and utilization, and knowledge of thermal equipment and power machinery, students will possess engineering capabilities in fields such as thermal and new energy power generation, power machinery, and refrigeration and heating, and be able to engage in engineering work such as equipment development, system design, operation management, etc.Practical Teaching: Universities usually set up important practical teaching links such as course experiments, metal processing internships, production internships, course designs, scientific research training, and graduation design or thesis writing to enhance students' practical abilities and innovation awareness.Employment Direction: Graduates can work in enterprises related to energy, power, machinery, aviation, refrigeration, etc., research institutes, design institutes, and administrative departments, engaging in research and design, product development, manufacturing, testing, and management in areas such as thermal energy engineering, power engineering, refrigeration engineering, and new energy.
